terms.definition: Code that translates a host or vendor interface, such as Excel or ETABS, to and from reusable library contracts without owning duplicate engineering formulas.
An explicit operation that may access COM, mutate a workbook or model, run analysis, or create a file and therefore is outside a pure calculation.
Evidence from the supported installed application and exact candidate; a successful library test or compiled XLL does not establish it.
The declared conditions under which an engineering method or result is valid for the supplied geometry, actions, materials, code profile and context.
A recorded decision by an authorized person; it is distinct from calculation execution, an engineering pass and result completeness.
A resistance or response limit calculated for a declared section and basis; it is not by itself a demand check or whole-member approval.
Comparison of declared demand and resistance or rule criteria, with applicability, evidence and an engineering outcome.
The semantic operations deliberately maintained in both native Python and native .NET implementations.
Whether all checks required by the declared workflow profile were evaluated with acceptable applicability; it is separate from pass or fail.
Force and moment components that belong to the same source case, step, station and result row and may be used together when the target check supports that action basis.
A versioned input and expected semantic outcome replayed across implementations, including valid, invalid, boundary and unsupported cases.
Detail, bar path, BBS, quantity, price or formwork-measurement data derived from resolved member geometry and declared fabrication or measurement policies.
An operation that determines a required or selected engineering solution under a declared scope; it remains distinct from checking supplied details and from approval.
The normalized values actually used by a calculation, including the origin of profile-resolved or derived values.
The qualified role accountable for design-code interpretation, supported applicability and engineering assurance acceptance.
The result of an applicable calculation or check, such as pass or fail, kept separate from software execution, completeness, freshness and approval.
Whether software completed, rejected or did not run an operation; successful execution does not imply an engineering pass.
Whether a result remains bound to the current effective inputs, source/model state and calculation basis.
A callable calculation or substantial workflow that operates on explicit data without requiring a running Excel, ETABS, HTTP or UI process.
An immutable, unit-normalized and source-identified representation of analysis actions suitable for replay without a live ETABS session.
A stable language-neutral identifier for one engineering or application operation whose Python and C# projections preserve the same meaning.
A value whose absence has a declared meaning and resolution rule; null, blank, zero, defaulted and derived states are not interchangeable.

A documented public function or method contract with purpose, applicability, explicit inputs and units, outputs, diagnostics, provenance, compatibility and linked examples; it is not a person's engineering signature.
A new analysis execution and action snapshot required when a candidate changes geometry, stiffness, releases, offsets, self weight, loads or other model inputs that affect demand.
The Python or .NET package surface usable directly by ordinary callers, with engineering behavior independent of Excel and ETABS host state.
A versioned declaration of supported member forms, action bases, checks, methods and required inputs used to judge applicability and completeness.
Structured identity for the code rule, table, worked example, data revision or acquired artifact supporting a result.
A complete beam-design journey whose inputs can be entered or loaded without ETABS and whose engineering calculations use the same reusable library as later automation.
A pure, deterministic Excel-callable calculation over supplied values that performs no live COM call, workbook mutation, model mutation or file creation.
